LEVEL_1_PUBLIC.label: Level 1 — PUBLIC
LEVEL_1_PUBLIC.description: Safe for investor application forms: mission, public demo, high-level architecture, public environmental problem, public team.

LEVEL_2_INTERNAL.label: Level 2 — INTERNAL
LEVEL_2_INTERNAL.description: Used for investor matching & draft proposals; requires explicit human confirmation before submission (financing scenarios, pilot budget, business model).

LEVEL_3_CONFIDENTIAL.label: Level 3 — CONFIDENTIAL
LEVEL_3_CONFIDENTIAL.description: Blocked from automatic form filling: unpublished technical architecture, proprietary algorithms, detailed data pipeline, unpublished research.

LEVEL_4_RESTRICTED.label: Level 4 — RESTRICTED
LEVEL_4_RESTRICTED.description: Strictly blocked from AI exposure and external forms: patentable inventions, API keys/credentials, private investor comms, personal PII, confidential contracts.

founder_team.value: GreenHope Founding Team — Climate AI, Urban Environmental Analytics & Climate Finance Architecture (Antalya / Türkiye)

problem.value: Cities in Türkiye and emerging markets face compounding urban air-quality degradation, municipal waste inefficiencies, and climate shocks, yet struggle to convert environmental data into bankable, MRV-verified climate projects eligible for MDB and bank financing.

solution.value: GreenHope is an AI-enabled urban climate resilience and environmental intelligence platform linking city pilots (air quality, waste optimization, urban resilience) directly to verified MRV metrics and climate finance mobilization (GreenHope -> city pilot -> measurable climate impact -> financing -> scale).

technology.value: Modular cloud + IoT environmental telemetry integration, geospatial urban analytics, automated MRV reporting dashboards, and KAG+RAG climate finance matching.

ai.value: Applied AI combining environmental forecasting, anomaly detection for urban air/waste systems, and Knowledge-Augmented Generation (KAG) + RAG for transparent MRV and climate finance readiness.

environmental_impact.value: Measurable reductions in urban air-pollution exposure, landfill methane/waste leakage, and municipal energy waste via real-time operational intervention.

climate_impact.value: Dual mitigation & adaptation impact: quantified tCO2e reductions (waste circularity & urban efficiency) alongside real-time urban heat/air-quality resilience for municipal populations.

air_quality.value: Hyper-local urban air-quality monitoring, PM2.5/NOx hotspot detection, and predictive mitigation guidance for cities and industrial zones.

waste.value: Smart municipal waste analytics supporting COP31 Türkiye Zero Waste priorities: diversion tracking, methane reduction, and circular recovery verification.

cities.value: Designed for rapid deployment in Mediterranean and emerging-market municipalities (initial flagship pilot focus: Antalya & Turkish metropolitan cities, scalable across EMEA/Asia/Africa).

target_users.value: Municipalities, metropolitan climate departments, organized industrial zones (OIZs), development banks/commercial lenders requiring verified MRV, and urban sustainability operators.

pilot.value: 12-month Flagship Municipal City Pilot (Antalya / Türkiye) demonstrating real-time air quality + waste MRV dashboards and generating investment-grade impact metrics for follow-on bank/MDB scale-up.

geography.value: Initial pilot: Antalya, Türkiye (COP31 host city); regional expansion across Türkiye, Europe/EMEA, and emerging markets.

funding_requirement.value: USD 50,000 – USD 250,000 initial city pilot & technical preparation funding (scaling to USD 1M–5M blended/project finance alongside MDB/bank municipal partners)

current_stage.value: Pilot-Ready Prototype & COP31 Antalya Active Engagement (Startup Zone / Climate Finance Hub)

business_model.value: B2G / B2B SaaS + MRV analytics licensing for municipalities and green-finance institutions, plus project-preparation & impact-verification fee layer for blended climate finance pipelines.

revenue_model.value: Recurring annual municipal/enterprise platform subscriptions + verified MRV reporting modules tied to green loans/bonds.

annual_revenue.source: NOT YET PROVIDED — Founder must confirm audited/current revenue

ip_status.value: [CONFIDENTIAL — BLOCKED FROM AUTO-SUBMIT] Proprietary KAG+MRV sensor-fusion algorithms, urban emissions scoring weights, and patent-pending pipeline architecture.

open_source_policy.value: Selective open standards for public climate transparency & MRV schemas; core predictive AI models and proprietary algorithms remain closed/protected IP.

partners.value: Active COP31 Antalya engagement across Startup Zone, Climate Finance Hub, Turkish municipal sustainability stakeholders, and climate finance working groups.

evidence.value: Working GreenHope live prototype, verified COP31 investor intelligence database, structured MRV impact methodology, and documented Antalya urban pilot design.

metrics.value: Target pilot KPIs: 15–25% urban waste sorting/diversion uplift, real-time air-quality coverage across pilot districts, ISO/MRV-ready quarterly tCO2e & resilience reporting.

financial_model.value: Phased capital plan: Phase 1 Pilot ($50K–$250K catalytic grant/pilot finance) -> Phase 2 Multi-City Türkiye Rollout ($1M–$3M blended DFI/bank finance) -> Phase 3 Regional Scaling.

restricted_secrets.value: [RESTRICTED — NEVER EXPOSED TO AI OR EXTERNAL FORMS] Vault master keys, API tokens, unfiled patent disclosures, personal founder IDs, private investor emails.
